embedTemplate:
<iframe
  id="booking-form-contact-us"
  src="https://app.dilvon.com/book/prestige-signature-cleaning/contact-us?embedded=true"
  style="width:100%;border:0;min-height:600px;display:block;"
  loading="lazy"
  title="CONTACT US"
></iframe>
<script>
  (function () {
    var formOrigin = new URL("https://app.dilvon.com/book/prestige-signature-cleaning/contact-us?embedded=true").origin;
    var f = document.getElementById('booking-form-contact-us');
    if (f) {
      var src = new URL(f.getAttribute('src'));
      src.searchParams.set('embed_origin', window.location.origin);
      f.setAttribute('src', src.toString());
    }
    window.addEventListener('message', function (e) {
      if (e.origin !== formOrigin) return;
      if (!e.data) return;
      if (e.data.type === 'lovable-form-resize') {
        if (f && typeof e.data.height === 'number') {
          f.style.height = e.data.height + 'px';
        }
      }
      if (e.data.type === 'lovable-form-redirect' && typeof e.data.url === 'string') {
        try {
          var target = new URL(e.data.url, window.location.href);
          if (target.origin !== window.location.origin && target.origin !== formOrigin) return;
          if (e.data.openInNewTab === true) {
            window.open(target.toString(), '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
          } else {
            window.location.href = target.toString();
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    });
  })();
</script>
